resources.string: Enter the access address of dsh on your computer (Tailscale domain, e.g. https://my-machine.my-tailnet.ts.net/). Keep the Tailscale app connected (VPN icon) on this phone.
Invalid address: enter a domain (e.g. your-machine.your-tailnet.ts.net)
Tailscale is not connected: open the Tailscale app and connect first.

Please check: 1) dsh is running on the computer; 2) Tailscale is connected; 3) the address is correct. Note: configuration/credential pages (models, plugins, permissions, etc.) are loopback-only on the computer (HTTP 403) — dsh upstream security design.
No file picker available on this device
